nom: Charlotte Tilbury Cryo-Recovery Depuffing Eye Serum

avis.texte: I tried this product in the store with a little eye irritation. I should have known better than to buy it. Wearing it the next day was even worse. It's way overpriced and not worth the hype. CT should stick to makeup and not skin care products.

This serum irritated my eyes a little when I tried it on in the store. I tried it again the next day. It was worse and I returned it. I can't believe I was talked into buying it in the first place. It's over priced for such a small tube of product.

Been using this for about a year now and it's the best. I use it in the morning as soon as i wake up and my underye is a little puffy. The applicator is cold and the formula along with the cold applicator depuffs my undereye in seconds. I will always have a back up on hand.

I have only used for about 2 weeks now so I will continue using it and update with progress or to see if I would recommend buying again in the next 2 months or however long the product will last. It applies nicely and the metal applicator is nice and good to use if you aren't feeling like pulling out the ice gloves from the fridge lol Doesn't leave your skin feeling tacky or sticky, it seems to soak into my skin very nicely and lays well with my other serums.
